_help: Copy this file to a new name (for example specs/mybrand.json), then change the values. Lines that start with an underscore are notes and are ignored. Everything here is optional: delete a line and the plain default is used.
name: Example Brand
_help_font: Your brand font as a .ttf or .otf file. Put the file next to this brand file, or in a fonts folder, and write its name here, for example "fonts/Montserrat-Bold.ttf". A font name that is installed on the computer also works, for example "Arial Bold". null means: use the best bold font this computer has. Captions always draw in this one font.
_help_colours: Hex colours: a # and six characters. text_color is the caption colour. accent is the one highlighted word on a card, and the page counter on carousel slides.
_help_background: type gradient: top colour in "from", bottom colour in "to". type solid: one colour in "color". type image: a picture in "path" with "motion" of hold, drift or push.
_help_shadow: A soft shadow keeps white type readable on any picture. Turn it off with "enabled": false for a flat, quiet look.
_help_layout: line_height is the space between lines (1.14 is normal). max_lines is the most lines one card may use. Carousel slides use max_lines_stills, and the first slide uses cover_lines. handle is the small footer text on carousel slides.
_help_footage: Only used by caption_video.py, when captions go on your own footage. caption_position is lower, center or upper. caption_nudge moves the captions down (plus) or up (minus) by that many pixels.
_help_preview: These two lines make this brand file renderable on its own, so you can see your look before you make real content: python3 bin/make_clip.py specs/example-brand.json. Your real content goes in a separate spec file (see specs/example-clip.json).
